title: Cost per Textbook Calculator
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Calculate what one generated textbook costs on an owned machine and what it must sell for at a stated margin, then explore five inputs.

educational.topic: Diagnosing Failures, Reporting, and Cost per Textbook
learningObjectives: The learner will calculate the cost per textbook and the price at a stated margin to within 1 dollar for 3 scenarios.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Committed calculation with two attempts, followed by free exploration
keyQuestions: Halving the utilization doubles the cost per book, while a 10% change in the yearly cost moves it by 10%. Explain which input an owner has more control over.
commonMisconceptions: A faster model always lowers the cost per book.
The cost is set by the electricity.
A machine's cost per book does not depend on how often it is used.

chapter_title: Diagnosing Failures, Reporting, and Cost per Textbook
